singlePurpose: An independent, user-operated workspace for managing Alibaba.com international products, image and video assets, RFQs, trade and logistics through documented APIs, including publishing a selected gallery image to the user's connected business social account.

permissions.justification: Stores encrypted gateway credentials using an optional passphrase or a random device key, settings, onboarding state, redacted product task metadata and an optional scoped social BFF device token. Derived unlock keys persist in trusted chrome.storage.local, not the passphrase or plaintext tokens. This allows browser restarts and extension updates without unlocking again; there is no idle auto-lock. Manual locking removes recovery keys in passphrase mode, including both TOP and IOP tools when locking the workbench; device-only mode keeps its device key and requires an explicit unlock click. Copying the full browser profile may decrypt credentials. Old locked records require the original passphrase once. Redacted diagnostics remain session-only. Local/session/sync storage is restricted to trusted extension contexts. Only to-dos use chrome.storage.sync, with local pending changes when writes fail; credentials and recovery keys never sync. Optional S3 configuration uses separate AES-GCM ciphertext in local storage and a non-exportable device key in local IndexedDB, with no additional password. Clearing S3 configuration removes both. Video receipts and recovery metadata use local IndexedDB without file bytes, Base64, source or signed URLs, or credentials. Product/RFQ edits stay in page memory; legacy drafts are not restored or automatically deleted.

Runs fixed packaged code only in the known Alibaba Application Center and OAuth tabs after the user explicitly starts credential acquisition. It does not execute remote code, collect the website password, accept agreements, or bypass human verification.
Sends user-initiated, signed HTTPS requests to the documented Alibaba.com Open Platform gateway.

Chrome grants only the specific host requested when a user starts credential acquisition, confirms the actual OAuth callback, configures a custom gateway or S3-compatible asset storage, pairs a user-controlled social publishing BFF, or explicitly transfers an external image. The independent IOP authorization tool requests only openapi-api.alibaba.com and the merchant's registered Callback origin on a user gesture; it does not collect Alibaba website passwords. Only the exact one-vegetable-auth.pages.dev site can open the tool or deliver a task-bound callback, never read or export secrets. S3 requests, including video multipart staging, use the existing grant for the configured storage host and are signed in the extension background. Grants are revocable under Logs > Diagnostics and data; no new permanent host grant is added.
